decisions.reason: It remains closely tied to the firm's core second-channel authentication and secure communication capabilities, so despite its disappearance as a visible website item the firm can still learn from and improve it within its existing knowledge base.

Mobile PDF signing fits the firm's identity and online signing trajectory, although the lack of later website visibility suggests some risk that it is folded into broader solutions rather than continued as a distinct product.

This architecture is highly aligned with the firm's deepest cryptography and platform competences, making it the kind of core security capability that absorptive capacity strongly supports retaining and refining.

Although related to the firm's security offer, the hardware-token format is less central to its software-led cross-channel identity strategy and the weak later visibility points to reallocating resources toward more scalable app-based and platform products.
